description: Spain-based managed AI inference platform with an OpenAI-compatible serverless API and dedicated endpoints.
residency_notes: The live serverless catalog marks every listed model with an ES datacenter. Nextbit's terms say other endpoints may use infrastructure inside or outside the EEA unless explicitly designated EU-resident.
prompt_training_notes: Nextbit's terms state that API request data may be retained for up to 90 days for service maintenance, diagnosis, and reliability improvement, but is not used to train or fine-tune models.

sources.notes: Public first-party live serverless catalog with exact model IDs, modalities, limits, features, sampling parameters, datacenters, quantization, and per-token pricing.
Official OpenAI-compatible API base URL, authentication, Chat Completions, and streaming documentation.
Official infrastructure-location, retention, service-improvement, and no-training terms.

verification.notes: Provider identity, API contract, live serverless catalog, prices, Spain datacenters, and data terms verified against first-party sources. Gateway routing remains intentionally disabled.
